description: Resolve the effective hourly rate for a user on a given date in a matter, using the matter's default rate table (user-specific rate first, then the organization role, then the table default). Returns the hourly rate in integer minor currency units (e.g. cents) and the currency, or nulls when no rate applies.

date.description: Date to resolve the rate on (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

userId.description: User ID to resolve the rate for
